nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Nose Pore Pimple Patches

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or congested skin report the patches pull visible oil, dirt, and gunk from nose pores, with several calling it their most effective option for that concern.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination (recently drier) skin found the patch worked better once integrated after her routine rather than before it.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer who does not consider herself sensitive still broke out from the adhesive, and others without naming sensitivity report itching or irritation during wear.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing her skin as normal used the strips for long-standing nose blackheads and saw most of them gone after one overnight use.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers describe visible blackheads pulled out of nose pores after one overnight use, with several saying blackheads present for years were markedly reduced; a few report no change at all in blackhead appearance.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers used the patch on active pimples, cystic spots, or whiteheads and report faster healing or gunk extraction; others say it did nothing for an existing pimple and they still had to pop it themselves, and one reports new whiteheads appearing after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily noses describe the patch absorbing or trapping excess oil overnight and skin feeling less oily and smoother afterward; one reviewer felt it only trapped oil in place without removing anything.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note itchiness or mild irritation during wear, and one describes redness risk if the patch is removed carelessly; no reviewer reports lasting barrier damage.
concerns.dehydration: Not discussed by reviewers as a concern.

aspects.libelle: Packaging hard to peel and separate
Poor adhesion or falls off overnight
Good value for cost per patch
Shape awkward for some nose sizes

extraits.titre: Caused Breakouts All Over My Nose
extraits.texte: I never review products, but I just had to for this one. I have been on a skin journey and everything was going well until I tried this product. It did not work at all, and the adhesive caused my entire nose to breakout into little whiteheads right before a wedding. I don't even have sensitive skin and I followed all the directions. Extremely disappointed, please do not buy.

The mighty pimple patches, work very well for me, and because I have many clogged pores on my nose, I thought I should try this. My advice is to make sure that after washing your face, you put on the patch and then do the rest of your skin care. it was interesting for me because I had a pimple and I put the patch over it, and no gunk came out. However, at the spot right next to it that had a clogged pore had a lot of gunk on the patch when I took it off the next night. I have a skin care routine which I didn't have when this worked better for my pimples. I find that this works even better on my pores and I see a lot of gunk come out. It also makes my pores look slightly smaller. Again, just make sure you don't apply any skin care products before using this. I also used to have very much combination skin. my skin has been dry recently and had no acne. I have is the pores with lots of gunk on my nose, so I would recommend to a friend because I think that it works differently on each person and that it could work better possibly on somebody with a lot of pimples.

I have blackheads on my nose and some on my cheeks, and i have used charcoal nose patches in the past but they never worked. I used one of these nose patches overnight, and almost all my blackheads were gone within one use!! My pores also shrinked. Not to mention, it was so satisfying seeing all the gunk on the nose patch. I am definitely going to buy this pack again when i finish this. Only problem with this is that the nose patch can itch my nose. However, I highly recommend this especially if you have blackheads on your nose!

I have normal skin but on my nose there are many blackheads and I've had blackheads on my nose since I was 11. In the past I have tried using the charcoal nose strips but the blackheads would not go away! So I used a nose strip from Hero and used it overnight, and when I took it off in the morning most of the blackheads on my nose were gone!! I was pretty surprised for it being the first time. Definitely worth the price. I will repurchase again when I run out.

extraits.titre: BEST FOR MY DEEP OILY ZITS
extraits.texte: I love this product!! I get very large zits that seem to be only oil and these patches work great! I actually use this nose patch on my chin since the chin patch is too small and I break out on my chin more than my nose.

I have been using these on my forehead and nose and they are so helpful for getting all the gunk out of my pores. It is actually so gross peeling it off in the morning and seeing how much stuff was clogging my pores. My skin feels so much smoother and less oily after use, it's fantastic.

I personally wouldn't recommend this product… like many other reviews have said, the packaging sucks. It's hard to peel without stretching or messing it up, and I've tried being gentle with tweezers + taking my time peeling. The way it tells you to do it on the packaging doesn't work either, because it sticks to the outer plastic really good. It also didnt stick to my nostrils very well, was a pain to get around my nose piercings too. With other patches I'm able to just cut around it and it'll restick no problem, this brand just has a hard time sticking in general. I will say it has worked on some of the pimples I've had but not always, and I also experienced itchiness like 75% of the time which is extremely odd. I got these to give a shot because my friend raves about their spot patches, but tbh im just going fo stick with my curology and panoxyl patches because those have yet to fail me.
